dedupe_keys.name: energy related co2 emission accounts and datasets for 40 emerging economies in 2010 2019

description: The CEADs collaboration led by Tsinghua University publishes energy-related carbon-dioxide accounts for forty emerging economies from 2010 to 2019. The inventories distinguish 47 economic sectors and eight major energy categories, including biomass combustion. Subnational inventories are provided for 28 of the forty economies. Zenodo supplies a national CSV and a ZIP of subnational emissions, publicly and free under CC-BY-4.0. The producer standardised sectors using available energy and economic statistics, whose quality and detail vary between countries. This creates uncertainty in comparisons and in using the accounts as direct measurements of facility emissions. The tables can calibrate regional energy and industrial decarbonisation scenarios or estimate emissions associated with changes in sector demand. They complement global gridded inventories with economic-sector accounts and subnational statistical detail. The deposited values and sector mappings were not independently checked.
